nodes.label: Human-language INCAR Builder (guided option picker)
nodes.rationale: Let users build an INCAR by picking labelled choices, not typing VASP tags: enums become dropdowns of plain-language options, free numerics become number+unit fields. One declarative catalog drives GUI, CLI --help, and the NL builder; no per-field code, reuses set_incar_value for writing.

nodes.label: incar_catalog Declarative Catalog (IncarField / IncarOption)
nodes.rationale: Data only, no logic: three widget kinds (choice/number/bool) cover the whole UI mapping; enum values filled from the VASP wiki per tag, not from memory.

nodes.label: NL Builder (phrase to INCAR via catalog labels)
